app.name: cuecard
app.tagline: Your film's subtitles, word by word.

home.title: Load subtitles
home.subtitle: Drop an .srt or .vtt file to get started. Title search comes in the next step.

reader.searchPlaceholder: Type 2 or 3 words from the line
reader.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# line found} other {# lines found}}
reader.noResultsHint: Try fewer words, or a rare word from the sentence: the search forgives typos, not invented words.
reader.swipeHint: Swipe left or right to move, or use the large buttons.
reader.keyboardHint: Arrow keys ↑ ↓ to navigate, / to search.
reader.empty: This file contains no readable lines.
reader.longPressHint: Press and hold, then drag, to select a whole expression.

errors.unsupportedFile: Unrecognised format. An .srt or .vtt file is required.
errors.noCues: No line could be read from this file. Check that it really is a subtitle file.
errors.dictionaryNotFoundHint: It may be a proper noun, slang, or a form too rare for this dictionary. The links below often do better.
errors.dictionaryRetryHint: The links below still work, and the word is still readable in the line.

external.missing_key: Missing API key for {service}. Set it in .env.local, then restart the app.
external.unauthorized: {service} rejects the API key. Check that it is correct and active.
external.rate_limited: Too many requests to {service} at once. Wait a few seconds.
external.quota_exhausted: {service} download quota spent for today. It resets during the day; meanwhile you can load an .srt by hand.
external.upstream: {service} is answering oddly. This is not on your side.
external.invalid_request: The app made a request it should not have. That is a bug, not something you did.

definition.showMore: {count, plural, one {+ # more definition} other {+ # more definitions}}
definition.expressionNoEntry: The English dictionary only indexes single words: it has no entry for an expression.
definition.expressionHint: WordReference below covers expressions and phrasal verbs. Contextual meaning arrives in step 4.

titles.noResultsHint: Try the original English title: that is usually the one TMDB knows best.
titles.uploadHint: Useful when OpenSubtitles has nothing, or the daily quota is spent.

subtitles.none: No English subtitles for this title.
subtitles.noneHint: OpenSubtitles has nothing indexed for this TMDB id. A hand-loaded file works just as well.

timing.gotoHelp: Type the time your player shows. The calibrated offset is applied automatically.
timing.calibrateHelp: This line sits at {time} in the file. Type the time your player shows at that same instant: the offset is remembered for this title and this source.
timing.offsetOutOfRange: An offset of {offset}: the time is most likely mistyped.
timing.offsetNotSaved: Offset applied for this session but not remembered: saving failed.
